name: A-Zenith Home Furnishings Co., Ltd.
summary: A-Zenith Home Furnishings Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells mid-to-high-end Shanghai-style classic and modern furniture products in China. The company offers aluminum wood doors and windows, stair handrails, aluminum-wood doors and windows, and stair railings; and engages in zirconium-titanium ore beneficiation and processing. It is also involved in the wholesale of furniture and household items; residential interior decoration and renovation; sales of building decoration materials; professional design services; house rental; furniture installation services; residential interior decoration; sales of building decoration materials; and professional design services.
